div.h2: Prophetic Word FAQ – What Is a Prophetic Word?
div.p: Everything you need to know before ordering your prophetic word service.

details.summary: What is a prophetic word and how does it work?
details.p: A prophetic word is a divinely inspired message that speaks to your specific season, revealing direction, encouragement and correction in line with Scripture. After you share your name and situation, time is spent in prayer and listening, and the message received is written out for you. Everything delivered is weighed against the Bible, so it confirms God's Word rather than replacing it.

details.summary: How accurate are your prophetic words?
details.p: Over 490 five-star reviews from clients worldwide describe details that were confirmed in their lives soon after reading. Accuracy comes from prayer, discernment and biblical alignment, never from guesswork or cold reading. You are always encouraged to test every word, keep what bears witness in your spirit, and confirm it through Scripture and prayer.

details.summary: How long does it take to receive my prophetic word?
details.p: Standard delivery is 24 to 48 hours from the moment your details are received. The $5 spiritual biblical word is usually delivered within 24 hours, while longer premium readings of 2000 words or more may take the full 48 hours. Urgent requests can often be prioritized — simply mention it when you message on WhatsApp.

details.summary: What information do I need to provide?
details.p: Only your first name, your age or date of birth, and a short description of the area you want clarity on such as relationships, career, health, finances or purpose. No sensitive documents, payment details in chat, or personal identification are ever required. The more focused your question, the more specific and useful your prophetic word will be.

details.summary: Can I get a prophetic word for someone else?
details.p: Yes. Many clients order a prophetic word as a gift for a spouse, child, parent or friend who is facing a difficult season. Provide their first name and a brief context, and ideally let them know a word is being sought on their behalf. Intercessory prophetic blessings are especially popular for families and for those walking through transition.

details.summary: What if I am not satisfied with my prophetic word?
details.p: If your word does not speak to your situation, message on WhatsApp within seven days and a follow-up session will be provided at no extra cost, with additional prayer and clarification on the points that felt unclear. Client care is personal and confidential, and the goal is always that you leave with genuine peace and clear direction.
